prompt:
We're finally moving forward with the LogiFlow database migration — all three on-prem Postgres servers need to go to Aurora before Q3. Last time we tried this it was a disaster (see the postmortem in docs/). This time we need a proper, thorough execution plan before anyone touches anything.

Please read through the project_brief.txt in the workspace, understand the full scope of what's involved, and produce a complete execution plan saved as migration_plan.md. The plan needs to be solid enough that the DBA team and the app owners can all follow it independently and know exactly what they're doing, what they're touching, and how they'll know if something succeeded or went sideways. Make sure blockers and risks are called out explicitly — especially the ones we already know about.
